prompt: Where do Clark Vernon's absences come from? Which applications recorded or changed them?
answer:
Clark Vernon (key 004688, Tenth grade, Ridgemont High School) has 51 absence records covering 44 different days this school year. The data is as of 2026-11-06. The applications named below are fictional samples from the demonstration data.

**Where the absences come from**

All 51 records are section-level attendance events (Ed-Fi resource `studentSectionAttendanceEvents`). There is one record per class missed.

| Group | Records | What they are |
|---|---|---|
| W-HIST (World History), Unexcused Absence | 44 | One record per day from 2026-08-25 to 2026-11-06, on 44 different days. |

On 2026-10-23, W-HIST appears in the excused group, so that day's W-HIST absence is excused. That makes 44 unexcused W-HIST records plus 8 excused records, which is 52, but the tool reports a total of 51. I can't explain that mismatch from this output. Clark has an unexcused absence in the same class, W-HIST, on nearly every school day for over two months. Nobody at the attendance office has reviewed or excused any of them. The only reviewed absences are the single-day, all-class absence on 10-23.
